_doc: World events (LW-001, WorldEvents). At every month boundary each event that is not already under way starts with probability monthly_chance in one region picked at random from `regions` (regions.json ids), lasting a random min_days..max_days. start_text/end_text are logged when it starts and ends ({region} = the region's name). modifiers apply in that region while it lasts: encounter_tags (extra encounters.json tags added to every exploration there, so events can have their own encounters), price_mult (multiplies what merchants there charge), qi_density (multiplies cultivation there). Active events are saved with the game. Optional `tournament` (LW-003): {rounds, prize: {items, manuals, reputation}} lets the player enter a bracket of `rounds` non-lethal spars in a row against generated cultivators of their own realm (each a stage tougher, no healing between); a win pays `prize.items` ({item_id: n}), one random manual from `prize.manuals` (items.json ids) and `prize.reputation` with the player's sect. Optional `defence`: {enemy, effects} lets the player beat one raider (enemies.json id, scaled to the player's realm and stage) for `effects` (shared Effects keys). Each can be done once per event instance. Optional `months` (WE-002): list of month numbers 1-12 (Calendar.month_of) in which the event may start; with monthly_chance 1.0 and one month it is a yearly fixed-date event. Optional `festival`: true marks a festival (journal line, UI). Optional `shop_items` (FEST-002): item ids (known, price > 0) the region's merchants also sell while the event lasts (shown last, marked (festival); give them no merchant tags so ordinary merchants never stock them). Optional `activity` (FEST-003, meant for festivals): {name, text, days >= 0, effects (shared Effects keys), bonus?: {attribute (attributes.json id), min, text, effects}}; anyone (mortals too) can take part once per event instance, taking `days` of time and applying `effects`; `bonus` text and effects are added when the attribute is at least `min`. modifiers.favor_mult (>= 1.0) multiplies the favor gained from chatting and gifts in that region (before the usual caps).

events.name: Beast Tide
events.description: Spirit beasts pour out of the deep wilds in a maddened tide, trampling everything in their path.
events.start_text: A beast tide boils out of the deep wilds of {region}! Hunters and fools rush in.
events.end_text: The beast tide in {region} ebbs away into the wilds.

events.name: Sect Tournament
events.description: The great sects hold an open tournament. Rogue cultivators and disciples alike test themselves in the ring for prizes and fame.
events.start_text: The great sects open a tournament in {region}. Any cultivator may enter the ring.
events.end_text: The tournament in {region} ends; the stands empty and the banners come down.

events.name: Auction Season
events.description: Collectors from across the realm descend on the markets. Prices soar, but rare goods change hands in every alley.
events.start_text: Auction season begins in {region}: merchants raise their prices as collectors flood the streets.
events.end_text: Auction season in {region} is over, and prices settle back down.

events.name: Demonic Incursion
events.description: Blood-path cultivators raid the land in force, harvesting the weak. Their slaughter fouls the spiritual qi.
events.start_text: A demonic incursion! Blood-path cultivators descend on {region}, and the air turns heavy with the smell of blood.
events.end_text: The demonic cultivators withdraw from {region}, leaving burned homes behind.

events.name: Qingming Ancestor Festival
events.description: In the clear, bright days of spring the mountain's disciples sweep the graves of the departed, burn paper offerings and share cold dumplings, remembering those who walked the Dao before them.
events.start_text: Incense smoke curls over the graves of {region}. The Qingming Ancestor Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The paper offerings have burned to ash at {region}; the Qingming Ancestor Festival is over.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Moon Festival
events.description: When the harvest moon is fullest, the market's traders hang lanterns from every stall, cut moon cakes for strangers and haggle with a lighter heart.
events.start_text: Round lanterns glow above every stall at {region}. The Mid-Autumn Moon Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The moon wanes over {region}; the Mid-Autumn Moon Festival is over.

events.name: Lantern Festival
events.description: On the first nights of winter the village floats paper lanterns down the river and burns incense for the ancestors. Strangers are fed and old grudges are set aside.
events.start_text: Paper lanterns drift down the river at {region}, and villagers burn incense for the ancestors. The Lantern Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The last lanterns burn out on the river at {region}; the Lantern Festival is over.

activity.name: Float a lantern
activity.text: You write a name on a paper lantern and set it on the river with the villagers. It drifts away among a hundred others.

bonus.text: Watching the lights follow the current, something about how qi finds its way settles in you.

events.name: Spirit Qi Tide
events.description: The earth's dragon veins surge. Spiritual qi thickens until even mortals can feel it on their skin.
events.start_text: The dragon veins beneath {region} surge: a spirit qi tide thickens the air with qi!
events.end_text: The spirit qi tide in {region} subsides.
